Book a live demo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Overview
 
 
 
 
 Unify your operations
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
IBM Maximo® Application Suite is a unified asset and facilities management solution that brings maintenance, inspections and reliability together in one place for critical equipment and infrastructure, using AI to help improve asset uptime, performance and value.

Built for operations, maintenance and facility teams, it helps address downtime, aging assets, workforce constraints and fragmented data.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Features
 
 
 
 One solution for all
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 AI in asset lifecycle management
 
 
 
 
 Enterprise asset management (EAM)
 
 
 
 
 Asset performance management (APM)
 
 
 
 
 Asset investment planning (AIP)
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI for the work that keeps the world running
 
 
Maximo delivers embedded AI across maintenance, field execution, reliability and planning to provide the right insights, recommendations and actions when and where they're needed. By supporting better decisions and automating work, teams can improve reliability, reduce downtime and operate more efficiently.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore AI for asset management
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Streamline operations with connected asset management
 
 
Maximo helps build a stronger foundation for reliable operations with enterprise asset management. Teams can manage work, asset history and maintenance processes in one place, with AI to surface insights, support prioritization and reduce time spent navigating disconnected systems. The result is more consistent execution, faster decisions and greater efficiency across daily operations.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore enterprise asset management
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Boost reliability with asset performance insights
 
 
Improve reliability with Maximo asset performance management, which uses AI, analytics and sensor data to detect issues early, support condition-based maintenance and help prevent failures. By turning asset condition insights into action, teams can reduce unplanned downtime, improve availability and extend asset life across operations.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore asset performance management
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Plan asset investments with more confidence
 
 
Make better decisions on when to maintain, refurbish or replace assets. Maximo asset investment planning helps connect asset condition, risk and financial impact so teams can evaluate scenarios, compare priorities and align investments to business goals, budgets and operational needs. This supports more effective capital planning and better lifecycle outcomes.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore asset investment planning
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
From Reactive Maintenance to Asset Reliability
 
 
Join us Aug 4, 10 AM ET to learn how leading organizations use AI and asset insights to reduce downtime and improve performance.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Reserve your spot today

 Use cases
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Plan, operate and optimize your assets
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Asset inspection
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Analyze images and video from cameras, drones and mobile devices to detect defects, anomalies and critical conditions earlier.

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore asset inspection

Schedule, dispatch and complete work more efficiently with mobile access to asset data and work orders.

 Health, safety and environment
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Integrate health, safety and environmental processes with daily work execution to help track incidents, assess risks, support compliance and streamline audits.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore health, safety and environment
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Maintenance management
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Bring maintenance planning, scheduling and execution together in a unified workflow, supported by a comprehensive asset and work registry that combines real-time and historical data with integrated work order management.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore asset management

Move from reactive to proactive maintenance with reliability workflows, failure mode analysis and recommended maintenance strategies.

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore asset performance management

Use real-time sensor and meter data to trigger maintenance based on actual asset condition instead of fixed schedules.

 Case studies
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Trusted by leading organizations
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Explore more real‑world case studies that show how organizations solve asset management challenges and drive measurable business value.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 See more case studies
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Spendrups Bryggeri
 
 
Spendrups shifted from schedule-based maintenance to a more proactive, data-led model across three brewery sites. With better visibility into equipment condition and performance, teams can focus on the work that matters most, improve production reliability and reduce waste. The result is a more efficient maintenance operation that supports consistent output and long-term sustainability.

Read full case study

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
EUR 380 million
 
 
annual business revenue supported by IBM Maximo
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
VPI
 
 
Following multiple site acquisitions, VPI needed a consistent way to manage assets, maintenance, safety and compliance across four power plants. With a centralized operating model and real-time visibility, teams can strengthen control over risk, track maintenance compliance more closely and improve planning. That helps support safer operations and more reliable power generation.

Read full case study

Downer
 
 
Downer uses connected asset data and predictive maintenance insights to keep more trains in service and reduce service-impacting failures. With earlier visibility into emerging issues, maintenance teams can act before problems disrupt operations. This approach helps improve fleet reliability, optimize long-term support and keep passengers moving safely and on schedule.

Sund & Bælt Holding A/S
 
 
Sund & Bælt is rethinking how it inspects and manages major infrastructure assets, including bridges, tunnels and concrete structures. By combining drone imagery, AI-powered visual inspection and digital asset data, teams can detect defects earlier, reduce manual inspection effort and plan maintenance more precisely. The result is a safer, more scalable approach to infrastructure management.

Transport for London
 
 
Transport for London brought maintenance activities onto a common platform to better support technicians working across a vast and complex network. With easier access to work orders, asset information and shared processes, field teams can respond faster and work more consistently. That helps improve day-to-day execution, strengthen coordination and keep services running reliably.

Royal Melbourne Hospital digitized facilities management to better coordinate the high-volume services that support patients, staff and care teams. With more standardized workflows, mobile task management and stronger operational visibility, teams can respond faster and reduce manual effort. This creates a more efficient service environment across a complex hospital network.
